changes.evidence: Marvel Zombies episode 3: Wanda's tribute food turns New Asgard's Asgardians into zombies (Asgard there falls); Valkyrie flees with Kamala's group, pilots the Commodore into space for them, and in episode 4 fights alongside them in Paris until she is killed. Fandom lists her only affiliation as the Zombie Outbreak Survivor Groups.

Marvel Zombies episode 1: Yelena (codename Black Widow) holds the North Institute with Melina and Alexei and the Black Widows; Melina orders the Black Widows to take positions, Ghost takes them out and the base falls; Yelena then leaves with Kamala's group. Fandom's Black Widows (Zombie Outbreak) page lists Yelena as a member.
